checks.title: Control Tower
checks.summary: 1 item(s) to settle with Control Tower, 4 informational.

findings.title: Moving out of the registered OU Retail unenrolls the account from Control Tower
findings.detail: Control Tower governs accounts through their OU, and Sandbox (ou-fern-sand) is not registered with Control Tower. After the move the account is no longer enrolled: the 3 preventive guardrail SCP(s) of the old OU chain stop applying (see the SCP diff), 4 detective control(s) stop reporting, baseline updates stop and the landing zone shows the account as drifted until it is unenrolled properly. Unenroll it from Account Factory first if leaving governance is the intent; otherwise register Sandbox and move the account with Control Tower's update-account flow.

evidence.note: version 3.3, status ACTIVE, drift IN_SYNC; home region eu-west-1; governed regions eu-west-1, eu-central-1
OU Retail registered: baseline 4.0, status SUCCEEDED, drift IN_SYNC

findings.title: 3 preventive control(s) stop applying: AWS-GR_CLOUDTRAIL_ENABLED, AWS-GR_CONFIG_ENABLED, AWS-GR_RESTRICT_ROOT_USER_ACCESS_KEYS
findings.detail: Enabled on the source OU chain and not on the target's. Preventive controls stop applying to the account after the move.

findings.title: Account was vended by Account Factory; move it by updating provisioned product fernhill-retail-prod
findings.detail: Account Factory records the OU as a parameter of the provisioned product. Changing the OU through the product (Service Catalog, update provisioned product, or the Control Tower console) performs the move and re-applies the baseline; moving it in Organizations directly leaves the product and the landing zone in drift.

findings.title: Sandbox is not a registered OU; the account stays outside Control Tower governance there
findings.detail: The landing zone of o-fernhill0001 governs only its registered OUs. No Control Tower controls apply to the account at Root / Sandbox, and Account Factory cannot enroll it until that OU is registered.
